mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AS01-AS04, AS06, AS08 tested against bacterial cells
mechanism_claims.claim_text: FE-SEM evidence supports bacterial membrane morphology disruption after peptide treatment, but it does not by itself quantify a pore model or prove an intracellular target.
direct_assay_types: FE-SEM bacterial membrane morphology after peptide treatment
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct imaging supports membrane damage context only; no exact per-peptide mechanism quantification is recoverable from local supplementary figures.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AS03, AS05, AS06, AS08 in POPC:POPG model membrane simulations
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Molecular dynamics simulations support a model where peptide assemblies form before membrane interaction/insertion and perturb the POPC:POPG bilayer.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Simulation evidence is mechanistic context, not a direct wet-lab proof for all antimicrobial assay peptides.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary source links activity trends to amphipathic cationic/hydrophobic patterning and LDLD backbone stability; this is design rationale and phenotype correlation, not an independent intracellular target assay.
